verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Zero Data Retention policy that auto-deletes API-submitted data within 24 hours, plus VPC-only enterprise deployment for full data control, giving AI-native users meaningful retention/deletion assurances. However, ZDR is gated to 'Growth' tier and above (exceptions for Studio-run jobs and persist_results), and community commentary notes DPAs are only available on Enterprise plans, suggesting weaker default controls for lower tiers. Missing for 10: explicit self-service deletion API/dashboard controls for all tiers, independent verification of retention practices, and clarity on default (non-Growth) tier retention behavior.
